verdict.rationale: Postman's docs strongly support shared, synced workspaces with role-based permissions and real-time collaboration (postman-docs-18/20/21/13/14), which directly matches the story. However, community evidence describes friction with this exact feature: forced cloud accounts to enable sharing/sync, per-seat pricing to unlock request sharing, and reports of collections/workspaces being wiped or requiring account login unexpectedly (postman-comm-4, -15, -17), undermining trust in reliable, frictionless syncing.
